tasks.name: Core-sensor classifier implementation
tasks.deliverable: Add physics-based core detector: compute per-sensor heat-rank (time-to-reach 80C from start) + cool-rank (retained-temp over 60s post-peak, using a common reference point to avoid peak-timing artifact). Combined score = heat_rank + cool_rank. If the lowest-score sensor differs from firmware's VirtualCoreSensor AND the score gap to 2nd place exceeds CORE_DETECTION_CONFIDENCE_GAP (config), override. Integrate into loader._identify_sensor_roles_for_curve() mirroring _apply_physics_based_surface_correction pattern. Add CORE_DETECTION_CONFIG block to config/constants.py. All 15 curve-boundary tests remain green; new core-classifier tests flip red to green.
